chunks: "Regarding the dead person, his eyes shed tears at the time of death, and that is upon beholding the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, so he sees what delights him."
Then he said: "Do you not see that a man sees what delights him and what he loves, so his eyes shed tears and he smiles."

key_terms.الْمَوْتِ: death; the final earthly moment being described
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person at the point of death
key_terms.تَدْمَعُ: shed tears or fill with tears
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.يَسُرُّهُ: what brings him joy or gladness

ai.seo_question: Why do a dying believer’s eyes shed tears at the moment of death according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a state at the moment of death in which the dying person’s tears are linked to beholding the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and seeing what brings joy. It presents death for the believer as a moment of glad vision and reassurance rather than mere distress.
